description: core-issues2.txt Phase 7 full-incident-trajectory extension of Cycle B2: for every scenario, a governed OOD category, evidence_sufficiency/next_step control targets, three auxiliary targets (sensor_reconstruction/future_concentration/travel_time), a Scout sampling sub-trajectory, and a Strategist planning sub-trajectory (exactly WNTR-verified). Never mutates data/learning-v2/cycle-b2.
ood_category_note: EXTREME_DEMAND/TANK_STATE_SHIFT/ROUGHNESS_MISMATCH are all classifiable by hydroswarm.training.ood_labels.classify_ood_category but this corpus's source scenarios (data/learning-v2/cycle-b2) never generated examples with those specific knobs pushed out of range -- the classifier is ready, the underlying scenario generation for those specific shift types was out of Phase 4's scope (see ood_labels.py's own docstring for the full per-category reproducibility note). UNSEEN_TOPOLOGY (coastal-branch) scenarios exist in development_holdout's manifest but were not processed by this pass -- coastal-branch is not one of this script's three loaded training topologies (see generate_trajectory_corpus.py's _train_topology_loaders); a coastal-branch-aware follow-up run would need that network loaded too.
scout_steps_note: Adaptive, not maxed out uniformly: ~47% of incidents resolve after Scout's first recommendation (should_continue_sampling becomes false or no further candidate exists), the remainder continue up to the 5-sample budget bound -- evidence this reflects real per-scenario evidence sufficiency rather than a fixed sampling count.
strategist_labels_note: Every incident in this corpus produced exactly 4 plan labels (the maximum_exact_simulations=3 prescreened bound plus the always-guaranteed NO_ACTION comparator) -- every scenario's network had enough candidate templates (isolatable links, downstream flush nodes, monitor nodes) to fill the bound; this is consistent with prescreen_top_plans' documented cap, not an anomaly, and was directly observed (not merely inferred) across all 13,150 records with zero exceptions.
hard_negatives: None deliberately curated in this pass (core-issues2.txt Phase 2/3's explicit hard-case list -- misleading sensors, near-tied plans, exposure-vs-pressure tradeoffs, etc. -- requires deliberate scenario-pair construction not attempted here, consistent with data/learning-v2/cycle-b2/dataset-report.json's own equivalent limitation for Cycle B2 itself). Every Strategist label set does include the required rejected/invalid-plan hard negatives organically, since plan_validity is read from real WNTR verification and not every candidate template is accepted for every network state.
trajectory_length_note: Scout sub-trajectories: 1-5 steps (bounded by MAXIMUM_SAMPLES_BOUND=5). Strategist sub-trajectories: exactly 1 step (single decision point per incident state, per Phase 3's own spec -- no multi-round plan revision in this pass).

tensor_shard_merge.description: scripts/merge_trajectory_targets.py re-attached ood_class/next_step/evidence_sufficiency/sensor_reconstruction/future_concentration/travel_time (flat per-example targets) onto data/learning-v2/cycle-b2/tensors-normalized/{split} shards, producing data/learning-v2/cycle-b2-trajectories/tensors-enriched/{split}. Scout/Strategist sequential data is NOT merged into these shards (does not fit ScenarioExample's flat .targets dict) -- remains in the JSONL files only.

stage1_smoke_screening.result: PASSED at real scale (200 train / 50 validation examples from tensors-enriched/{train,validation})

locked_test_discipline: The locked final test was not opened, listed, hashed, or referenced by any command run to generate this corpus. final-selection.json does not exist.
